Commentary.Commentary: 292 to win then, on a two-paced track. Australia would have to play out of their skins to chase this down. Stay tuned for their reply.

The 5th bowler hurt Australia as Marsh and Short went for 70 in 10 overs combined. Starc and Hazlewood were good in patches while Cummins and Zampa were excellent. Now, the fielding. It was extremely shoddy, something which you would expect Aaron Finch to speak about in the post-match presentation. They could have saved at least 15-20 runs, but for their lacklustre effort.

It was Heinrich Klaasen who summed up the pitch to perfection. Did not play too many strokes till he got to his 70s and only after being set, did he play his shots. Batsmen either side of him struggled to adapt to the conditions, even David Miller, who still got to 64 but played shots worth yielding 128. And that is where Australia let loose the grip.

Good finish by Australia but South Africa would be very happy with this total. They were staring down the barrel at 126/4 in the 27th over but Heinrich Klaasen and David Miller took the game away. The Aussies let the Proteas off the hook as a wicket there could have seen the Saffas get bundled under 200.

Heinrich Klaasen has a chat with Mark Nicholas. Says that it is an unbelievable feeling to get to that century. Agrees that the pitch is a good one to bat on but if you bowl well, you can get the wickets. Hopes that his bowlers mix up their pace and lengths and make use of the two-paced nature of the deck.
On middle, off a length, punched down to long on for a couple. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 291/7!

TOP EDGE, DROPPED! Klaasen gets across his stumps, looks to paddle and Starc bowls a slow full toss on off. The top edge is taken and the ball has gone straight up in the air. Carey has to go for the catch because fine leg is at the boundary. He keeps his eyes on the ball, runs backward, dives but cannot cling on. Two runs taken.
A low full toss, on the pads, played through point for a single.
Anrich Nortje walks in now.

OUT! BOWLED! That is a Mitchell Starc special and exactly why the single on the previous ball taken is questionable. A perfect yorker from Starc, on off, Maharaj backs away, looks to swing but misses. The off stump has been knocked out.

Oh.... missed! How did that miss the bat? How did that miss the stumps? Klaasen lines Starc up, coming from around the wicket and attempts the reverse paddle. Starc goes for the yorker, but dishes out a full toss. Heinrich misses and the ball just about shaves the off stump. Carey fumbles slightly and the batsmen pinch a bye. Questionable decision to run.

WIDE. Well done. A full toss, down the leg side, Maharaj misses his flick. An alert Klaasen is immediately off once the ball is bowled and by the time Alex Carey can react after diving to his left, the bye is completed. 5 balls still left.
A full toss outside off, Maharaj leans and drives it through the covers for a couple.

FOUR! And that is what happens when you misfield. Had Finch not fumbled on the previous ball, Klaasen would not have been on strike for this ball. Full and outside off, Heinrich just squeezes it between point and short third man! 10 from the over but Cummins has enjoyed a good day with the ball. 10-0-45-3 for him.
Poor from Aaron Finch. Klaasen punches this towards extra cover for what should have been a single. But Finch getting across to his left, takes it too lightly and fumbles, allowing the second.
Keshav Maharaj walks in but Klaasen will be on strike.

OUT! RUN OUT. Excellent yorker outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to dig it out but the ball takes the inside edge and rolls to the leg side. Andile is ball-searching and hence, is late to react to the single. He starts to run after Cummins gets to the ball and knows that he is gone for all money if the bowler hits. And Cummins, with all the time in the world, does not miss his shy at the bowler's end.
A slower bouncer, outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to play the upper cut but misses.
Andile Phehlukwayo walks in next, with 10 balls left in the innings.

OUT! Caught behind! Very close to a no ball but Cummins is just about fine. A short ball, around off, Miller gets across, looks to pull but finds no pace to work with. Just 124 kph. He is cramped for room and gloves it to the keeper. Miller starts to walk off but the umpire wants to check for the overstepping. Refers it upstairs and Cummins just about has something behind the line. That ends a magnificent 149-run stand. Could be a match-winning one. Not quite back to form, is Miller, but he at least got some runs today.
Caught! But is it a no ball? Nigel Llong has referred it upstairs. Cummins is just about okay...

FOUR! ADMONISHED! Finally Miller gets one away. He has been swinging at everything but misses. Gets one in his arc, around middle, fuller in length, looks to sing it out of the park and nearly does so. Lofted over the bowler, one bounce and into the long on fence.
Short and around middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one more. 10-0-63-1 for Hazlewood today. Not his usual stuff.
Goes again! A short ball, around off, Heinrich gets across and attempts the paddle-pull. Miscues it but has enough to clear Mitchell Starc at short fine leg. The running is good to fetch three runs.
FOUR! Cheeky from Klaasen. Gets across, receives a full toss on off and paddles it over the keeper to the fine leg fence! Moves to 110 from 108 balls. The stand is worth 141 from 126 balls.
A full toss, down the leg side, with fine leg up but DM flicks it straight to that man at short fine leg. Hazlewood gets away with only a single.
Another slower one, shorter in length, David swings hard again, only to miss.
A slower ball, on a length, Miller swings but misses.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl out. 9-0-54-1 so far.
SIX! WHOOSH! Spoils the over. Cross seam again from Cummins, around middle, Klaasen backs away and swings it miles over long on!
Excellent mix up of pace and length, a low full toss, wide outside off, David looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge towards square leg. A single taken. The stand moves to 130 from 121 balls.
Comes down the track this time and swings hard but misses again.
A slower ball, Miller looks to pull but misses.

CENTURY FOR KLAASEN! An emotional exhale for Heinrich Klaasen. Applause around the ground. A quality knock under immense pressure. This means a lot to him. A length ball, around off, Heinrich tucks it through square leg and yells, 'YEAHHHHHH!' after taking the single. Takes a moment for himself, then removes his helmet, looks at the ground and then slowly soaks in the applause. A matured knock.
The crowd getting excited... Klaasen on 99... Finch is just taking his time to set his field. Mind games...
Full and outside off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Full on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! SOUTH AFRICA GO PAST 250. 26 balls still left. Full and outside off, Miller leans and drives it to the left of the diving short extra cover fielder. No one in the deep.
A slower bouncer, around middle, David looks to hook but misses. He immediately looks towards umpire Nigel Llong at square leg and asks, 'Isn't that a wide?' No, is the answer.
Yorker outside off, squeezed towards third man for a single.

Huge shout for LBW, turned down. Was height an issue? A length ball outside off, coming in, Miller looks to have it out of the park but misses. He is hit on the pads and the ball rolls towards point. A leg bye taken. Too high. Miller was through his shot well before the ball arrived.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Miller throws his bat at it but misses.
Full and outside off, powered down to long on for one more. The stand moves to 120 from 110 balls.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a run.

Slower bouncer outside off, Miller is down the track, hence has to adjust playing his pull. Miscues it to deep mid-wicket. Gets a run and that will be his HALF CENTURY. Time for some Killer stuff now.
Short and outside off, Heinrich leaps and punches it through point for a run.
Full on middle, powered down to long on for a couple. Klaasen moves to 96 now.

A length ball, around off, Miller walks down the track, pushes it wide of mid off and initially yells, 'WAIT ON!' That is because he had to decide whether the ball is going to go past Aaron Finch at short extra cover or not. It does and the single is taken.
Pat Cummins returns. 7-0-19-2 so far.
Around off, coming in, worked to deep square leg for one more.
Full on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The cutter now, around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower ball, outside off, HK looks to push it through the covers but misses.
SIX! Wasn't quite in control but Klaasen gets the desired result. A short ball, around middle, Heinrich swivels, looks to pull but the ball flies off the top edge over deep backward square leg!
On middle, worked through mid off for a single.
Mitchell Starc is back. 7-0-35-1 so far.
Around middle, worked wide of long on for another single.
Flicks this to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Short and outside off, punched towards cover for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flicks this through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and misfields, allowing the third. 100-RUN STAND IS UP! In just 94 balls.
Excellent from Steven Smith. Short and outside off, Miller punches it through the covers but Smith flings himself to his right and makes a half-stop.
Around middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for one. Excellent comeback by Zampa after going for a biggie on the second ball of the over. He is done with the ball for the day. 10-0-48-0.
Full on middle, driven back to Zampa again.
David comes down the track again but Zampa fires it in the blockhole. Miller can only hit it back to the bowler.
Quicker one, around middle, well defended.
SIX! What a shot. Floated around off, the googly, Miller strolls down the track and lofts it through the line over long on! Miller moves to 40 from 42 balls.
Floated around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside leg, worked towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
Down the leg side, flicked behind square leg for one.
Full and around middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Action replay of the previous delivery. For a single this time.
Around off, turning in, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
MISFIELD. Short and outside off, Miller punches it through the covers. The fielder misfields at short extra cover and concedes a single.
Gamble from Finch. D'Arcy Short has been given the ball. 3-0-21-0 so far.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle now.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a couple. 10 from the over, Zampa's figures read 9-0-41-0 so far.
Comes down the track and whips it towards wide long on for one more.

FOUR LEG BYES! Full and outside leg, Miller looks to sweep but misses. Is hit on the pads and Zampa appeals for LBW but the umpire moves away. The ball races to the fine leg fence, beating Pat Cummins' desperate dive to his left.
Full and outside off, driven wide of long off for a single.
Backs away and punches it past the bowler, towards long on for a couple. 200 UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA. 64 balls left. 300 not out of sight.
Around off, punched straight to short mid-wicket.
Adam Zampa returns. 8-0-35-0 so far.
Full on middle, punched down to long on for one more.
Short and around middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Another length ball, quietly tapped through square leg for one.
Walks down the track and Hazlewood digs it short. But Miller adjusts well and dabs it uppishly, well wide of point towards third man. A run taken. The stand moves to 70 from 71 balls.
Slower ball, worked past the man at short mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a quick one.

SIX! WHAM! He is a powerhouse, he really is. Every time you see him, he impresses you. That is a remarkable shot. An absolute beauty from Klaasen. A length ball, outside off, Heinrich rocks back and heaves it over mid-wicket! Moves to 72 from 83 balls.
Full and around off, pushed down to long off for a run.
Clever stuff from Marsh. Changes his pace, rolls his fingers over the ball, nice off cutter, outside off, Miller looks to defend but misses.
Full and around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
A slower bouncer outside off, Klaasen looks to pull but mistimes his shot through square leg. A single taken. The stand moves to 60 from 63 balls.
A full toss now, punched past cover for a couple. 10 from the over.
FOUR! Goodness me, Miller has launhced himself into that shot. A length ball, around off, Miller takes a step or two forward and thumps it on the up between cover and mid off.
Excellent bowling. Inswinging yorker, around middle, watchfully dug out towards long on for a run.
A length ball, outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
EDGED, SHORT! Full and outside off, swinging away, David looks to drive straight but the ball takes the outside edge. Lands short of a diving Alex Carey, to his left.

50-RUN STAND IS UP. Crucially for South Africa, in 57 balls. Which means, in spite of Verreyne falling, the tempo has been maintained. Full and down the leg side, hint of reverse, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Josh Hazlewood is back on. 7-0-39-1 so far.
Length delivery around middle, Miller pushes it towards mid off and gets to the other end.
A little too straight, Miller works it wide of fine leg and two runs is taken.
Length again, this is pushed down to long on for one.
One more single! On middle, it is worked around the corner.
Good length and on middle, defended.
On the shorter side, this is pushed through covers for one.
Mitchell Marsh is back. 3-0-20-0, his numbers so far.
Another dot to end! So just the boundary in the over. On off, Miller keeps it out.
On middle, Miller works it but finds the man at mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Miller evades it.
Full and tailing back in but a little too straight. Miller looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the fuller side again around off, it is driven to cover-point.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! It is right in his zone, full and outside off. Miller creams it through covers for his first boundary. Good start to the over for the hosts.
A dot to end! A googly on middle, Klaasen works it to mid-wicket.
Miller steps out and works it down to long on for one.
Nicely tucked! On the pads, Miller goes back an works it towards fine leg for two.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for a single.
Cracked but straight to the fielder! The sweep shot comes out and it is hit hard through mid-wicket but straight to the fielder in the deep for one.
Floats it up on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Length delivery around off, Klaasen runs it down to third man for a run. 33 gone, South Africa 159/4.
On the stumps, Klaasen blocks it.
Full again from Starc. Klaasen chips it over covers and gets a couple.
Full on middle, Miller manages to flick it towards fine leg for a single.
Full on off, Miller pushes it to cover.
Fuller outside off, Klaasen checks his push towards cover and gets a single.
Mitchell Starc is back on! Finch needs him to get one of the two.
A quick single to end! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg and a run is taken.
On the pads again, Miller works it through square leg and takes one.
One more single! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A single now as Miller comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket.
On the pads, Miller works it towards mid-wicket.
An appeal but the umpire shakes his head! Around off and it turns back in slightly. Miller looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads. There was also an inside edge.

Drinks Break! It has been a good hour of play for the hosts. They have managed to steady the ship but unfortunately they have lost debutant Kyle Verreynne. Klaasen though is looking good and will look to continue his good work and hope Miller can join in as well. There is no need for the Aussies to panic but they will not want to make it difficult for themselves and would like to bowl out the hosts under 250.
FOUR! Delightful stroke and once again, the last over goes for a boundary. On a length and on middle, Klaasen stokes it past the diving mid on fielder and it races away.
Length and on middle, Klaasen keeps it out.
That is a beauty! Equally well played though. He gets it to tail back in, it is a yorker. Klaasen does well to take his front leg out of the way and jam it out.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Klaasen stays back and defends it onto the ground.
On middle, Miller works it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Good length and around off, defended nicely.

FOUR! The last ball spoils the over! A short one and on middle, Klaasen goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Also, fifty for HK. A good innings by him so far but he knows he needs to stay out there till the end. Second ODI fifty for him.
Very full and on middle, this is jammed down to long on for one.
Gets off strike now! He pushes it through cover-point for one.
One more dot! On middle, Klaasen works it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, Klaasen strokes it towards covers.
Very full and on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.

Good fielding again! End of an excellent over though for Australia! Once again this one is slightly short, Klaasen goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket. Short has some work to do again, he runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in.
Good length and on off, Klaasen guides it to point.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Klaasen looks to work it on the leg side but misses.
That stays low! On the shorter side and outside off, Klaasen looks to put bat to ball but it stays low and he misses.
FOUR! This is brilliant! Tad short again and it sits up to be hit! Klaasen pulls it well over mid-wicket. This time it is a lot straight and a boundary results.
Well fielded! Slightly short and Klaasen picks the length early. He rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket. Short in the deep runs to his left and pushes it in with a dive. Two taken.
Shorter and around off, it is pushed towards cover.
Josh Hazlewood is back!
Floated on off, Klaasen nudges it towards long off and keeps the strike.
Flighted on the stumps,  Klaasen blocks it.
Shorter on off, Klaasen punches it to the off side.
On the pads, Miller flicks it to the leg side and gets a single to get off the mark.
Floated leg spinner on off, Klaasen opens the face of his defensive bat towards point and gets a single.
Shorter on off, Klaasen punches it towards cover.
Adam Zampa is back on.
BEATEN! On a length and around off, Miller looks to defend but is beaten. End of a successful over for the visitors.
A short one on the body, Miller ducks under it.
The new man in is David Miller.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a sharp, sharp catch and the ploy to keep a short square leg works. It was Australia's plan to get on Cummins and ask him to bowl short, he does so and it brings the downfall of the debutant. A good innings form him though comes to an end but he will be disappointed he falls two short of a half ton. Also, he had hit that really well. Rocked back and smashes it but flat and straight towards Marsh there who takes a good catch. The stand which was going along nicely has been broken. Australia once again back on top.
A slower short ball outside off, Verreynne is a touch early in the pull. He mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Good running again! On a length and around off, Klaasen drops it towards point. KV wants a run and completes it with ease.
Just outside off, Verreynne guides it behind point for one.
Short ball on the body, Verreynne pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Length ball on off, Verreynne pushes it to cover.
Fuller on the stumps, Verreynne strokes it to mid on.
Bouncer! Klaasen pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Henrich turns it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Good length delivery on off, Klaasen flicks it to the leg side.
An appeal but nothing! A short one but down the leg side. Verreynne looks to pull but misses. Carey appeals but maybe to distract the umpire from not signaling a wide. It works though as it is a dot.
A good dipping slower one, just outside off. KV is foxed by it. In the end, he does well to jam it out.
Length and around off, it is pushed towards mid off.
Good length and on off, Klaasen guides it to point.
A slower one outside off, Klaasen looks to drive but he gets it off the bottom half towards cover.
A short one and on middle, it is ducked under.
Two to end! 12 from it. On the pads, it is worked around the corner for an easy two runs.
Goes back to bowling a length ball on off, it is pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over! This is a good one for South Africa. Short and on the body, it is pulled behind square on the leg side and it races away to the fence.
Good batting! Gets a boundary on the last ball and now works it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Lovely batting! Slightly over pitched and Marsh plays the price. It is on middle, Klaasen shows the full face of the bat and strokes it through mid on for a boundary.
Shorter and just outside off, it is guided down to third man for an easy run.
Mitchell Marsh is back on!
Angled into the batter, Verreynne works it wide of the fielder he found on the last ball and two runs is taken.
One more short ball and on middle, Verreynne pulls it but there is a fielder at square leg. It goes straight to him.
A short one and on middle, Verreynne ducks under it.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, Verreynne looks to go big but misses it by a long way.
One more length ball around off, Klaasen guides it towards third man and gets to the other end.
On the fuller side and around off, Klaasen pushes it towards mid off.
Pat Cummins is back for another burst! 4-0-14-1, his figures so far.
Leg spinner on middle, Kyle glances it to the on side and keeps the strike.
Flighted leg spinner on middle, Verreynne milks it to long on and gets to the other end.
Short on off and middle, Klaasen whips it towards cow corner and rotates the strike.
Floated on off, Kyle strokes it wide of mid off for a single.
Shorter on off, Verreynne defends it off the back foot.
Flatter and full outside off, Verreynne look to drive but hits it straight back to the bowler.
Well played! Nice and late! Just outside off, Verreynne guides it down to third man for one.
Good run again! On off, it is pushed towards cover and a run is taken. 100 up for South Africa. This is a good passage of play for them.
A full toss and Klaasen misses out. He strokes it straight to mid off.
On the pads, this is worked uppishly but well short of deep square leg for one.
Very full and on middle, it is jammed out towards the man at mid off.

Good running! On a length and around off, Klaasen drops it towards point and takes one. The 50-run stand is up between the two. A much needed one as South Africa were in trouble when the two joined association.
On the shorter side again, it is cut square on the off side for two. 24 runs in the last 3 overs.
Good shot! Very full and outside off, Verreynne strokes it through covers nicely and takes two.
One more single as this is eased down to long on for one.
On middle, it is quicker! Klaasen keeps it out nicely.
A single now as this is pushed down to long on.
Slightly shorter in length and outside off, it is mistimed towards the point fielder.
Change in bowling. Adam Zampa comes from the other end now.
A low full toss outside off, it is driven through covers for one.
Length and around off, blocked.
In the air but wide! Fuller and around off, it is driven, the ball seems to have stuck in the wicket and hence, it goes uppishly but well short of mid off. One taken.

Runs coming now for South Africa! It is a slower one and shorter in length. Verrreynne picks it, pulls it nicely through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives at the very end and pushes it back in. Saves two for his side.
On a length again and around off, it is pushed towards mid off.
Good length and around off, this is guided towards the man at point.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. 3-0-18-1, his numbers so far.
FOUR! A good end to an excellent over for South Africa! 13 from it. This is short and asking to be hit. Klaasen goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the shorter side and around off, this is slapped towards cover.

Good piece of work in the field again but more runs for the hosts! It is on the pads, Verreynee works it fine on the leg side. The fielder from short fine leg hares after it, slides and manages to push it back in just in time. Once again it is referred but the replays show again that the fielder has done well. He saves a run for his side.
More runs! Slightly shorter and around off, Verreynne stays back and cuts it through point for two.

Well fielded! Shorter and around off, Klaasen goes back and pushes it through extra cover. Finch gives it a chase from mid off and at the very end slides and pushes it back in. They go upstairs to check and it shows that Finch does well. Three taken.
Comes down the track and works it down to long on for an easy run.
Quicker on middle, Klaasen defends it towards point.
Darted on the pads, Klaasen flicks it to mid-wicket.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Flatter and shorter on off, Kyle punches it towards point for a single.
Full toss on off, Verreynne misses out on it and hits it towards short mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, Verreynne defends it on the leg side.
A single to end another good over for the Aussies! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the stumps, kept out.
One more single as Klaasen pushes it through covers.
On middle, Verreynne goes back and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Extra bounce there! Floats it up on off, the batter looks to defend but it takes off and hits the splice of the bat.
Flatter and around off, it is pushed to the right of the bowler.

Drinks break. Australia have thoroughly dominated the game so far and South Africa are on the mat. Inexperience is showing in their batting and currently Verreynne and Klaasen are trying to build a partnership. The middle phase when the conditions will ease out a bit and the spinners will be in action, let's see how the Proteas deal with that period.
A googly around middle, Verreynne punches it through mid on for a single.
Too full and on middle, fired in at 91 kph, Klaasen knocks it down to long on for one.
Loopy and full on off, once again Heinrich finds Smith at short cover after playing the front foot drive.
Much better this time. Full and flighted on off, Klaasen pushes it off his front foot to short cover.
Short again, wide outside off, it's stroked easily to sweeper cover for one. The leggie is yet to find the right length.
Shortish and close to off, Klaasen gets back and cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Time for some leg spin! Adam Zampa is into the attack now.
Flatter and shorter on middle, once again the batsman remains back and works it to deep square leg for a run.
Kyle has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Goes back to a short ball and works it through square leg for a run.

NOT OUT! It has pitched in line but is spinning down to miss the stumps. Good decision by the on-field umpire. Review gone for Australia. Very full in length from Short, Klaasen tries to sweep but misses and wears it on his front pad. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Aaron Finch takes the referral but the replays find Heinrich safe and sound.
Shout for an lbw! It's not been given. Aaron Finch has a word with his bowler and then takes the referral. Seems to be pitching outside leg. Let's see...
Shortish and on middle, Verreynne hangs back and punches it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Forces a full ball down to long on for a run.
D'Arcy Short to bowl.
Short ball down the leg side, Klaasen pulls it fine down the leg side and keeps the strike.
On the pads, Verreynne flicks it and gets a single.
Length delivery on off, Klaasen punches it through cover-point and gets a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Klaasen flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
Klaasen punches it but finds the fielder on the off side.
Marsh starts with a good length delivery on off, Verreynne punches it off the back foot away from the point fielder and gets a run.
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack for the first time.
Fuller on the stumps, Heinrich defends it.
On off, defended by Klaasen.
Around middle and off, Klaasen tucks it to the leg side.
Fuller on off, Klaasen taps it back to the bowler.
Length delivery on off, Klaasen defends it.
Short ball, Verreynne pulls it towards mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, Klaasen flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full around off, Verreynne strokes it towards point and gets a single.
Follows it up with a calm tap towards backward point.

FOUR! A shot Verreynne will remember for a long time. He gets his first boundary in ODIs. Good length ball around off, Verreynne gets on top of the bounce and punches it nicely through cover-point for a boundary.
Very full ball on the stumps, Verreynne defends it.
Good length delivery on off, Verreynne defends it off the back foot.
Powerplay 2 time now. Maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Klaasen leaves it alone.
On the pads, Verreynne flicks it uppishly but wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Bouncer! Verreynne ducks under it.
Length delivery on off, Verreynne plays it to point.
On the pads, Klaasen flicks it to the leg side and takes a quick run.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new batsman in the middle with South Africa reeling.

OUT! Chopped on! The top three South African batters are back in the pavilion inside Powerplay 1! Things are going from bad to worse for the Proteas in this game. The man in form, Bavuma is back for early showers as well. Cummins has his first and all the three pacers now have a wicket each. Back of a length delivery around off, the ball keeps high on Bavuma. He tries to tap it on the off side but gets a thick inside edge and the ball goes onto uproot the off pole.
Length delivery on off, Verreynne taps it to short third man.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high and it has been wided.

Good decision from the umpire. Good length ball on top of middle and leg, Verreynne looks to pull but the ball kisses the pocket of his trousers and goes to the keeper. Carey and the other fielders go up in appeal. Hazlewood though is not too excited and neither is the umpire.
Length delivery on off, Temba plays it to point and gets a single.
Length delivery on off, Bavuma defends it off his back foot.

In the air... DROPPED. Starc does all the hard work but fails to get the easy part right. Fuller ball on middle, Bavuma comes down a bit and looks to play it across the line. He gets a leading edge which goes behind mid on. Starc runs back and gets to the ball. He gets both his hands to it but fails to hold onto the ball. The batters take two.
Good length ball on off, Bavuma blocks it.
Good length delivery on off, Bavuma punches it through covers and gets three as the fielder mops it up before the ropes.
WIDE! Overcooked bouncer from Cummins. It is over the head of Bavuma and the umpire is back in action.
WIDE! Short ball down the leg side, Bavuma looks to pull but misses. The Australian players ask the question but the umpire stretches his arms and signals it as a wide.
Length delivery on off, Bavuma punches it on the off side.
Good length delivery around the pads, Bavuma flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a brace.
Uppish but safe again. On the pads, Verreynne flicks it uppishly but safely towards square leg for a single.

In the air but safe. Good length delivery on off, the ball sticks on the surface as it comes to Verreynne. He looks to defend but ends up chipping it wide to the left of the bowler. Cummins tries but cannot get there.
Bouncer! Verreynne sways away from it as this one is outside off.
Full on off, Bavuma pushes it to mid off to get through the over.

Verreynne is off the mark in ODI cricket. A very good shot from Kyle. Full on the pads, Verreynne flicks it through mid-wicket. He shows he is quick between the wickets as well and gets three as the fielder cleans it up before the ropes.
Good length ball on off, Verreynne punches it to mid off.
Length delivery on the pads, Verreynne start his ODI innings with a flick but finds mid-wicket.
The new man in is debutant Kyle Verreynne.

OUT! Caught behind! Big wicket for the Aussies, they have got the big fish. The South African skipper is back in the hut. Change of ends for Hazlewood works wonders for his team. Hazlewood bowls a typical Hazlewood delivery. It is on a length, just outside off. De Kock looks to run it down towards third man. The ball though is close to the stumps for Quinton to play that shot. He still goes for it and ends up kissing the ball to the keeper. He straightaway looks behind and Carey is not going to drop those. Hazlewood is up in joy. There was no need for this shot!
Good length ball on off, de Kock blocks it.
Change of ends for Josh Hazlewood.
Good running. Length ball just outside off, de Kock taps it wide of slip and takes a quick run. Good start from Pat Cummins, just 3 from his first.
On the pads, Bavuma tucks it to the leg side and gets to the other end.

Little noise but nothing from the umpire. Bouncer but towards the leg side. Bavuma looks to hook but misses. There is a little noise as the ball goes to the keeper. The Australian players put in a dire appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Finch does not review it this time and it is a good call as Ultra Edge later on shows that the ball did not hit the gloves.
Fuller on off, Bavuma pushes it to mid off.
Length delivery around off, Bavuma punches it to the off side.
Cummins starts with a good length delivery outside off, de Kock runs it down the third man for a single.
First bowling change of the game. Pat Cummins replaces Josh Hazlewood.
Fuller on middle and leg, Bavuma glances it to the right of mid on.
Bouncer from Starc! A typical fast bowler's response. It is wide outside off and Bavuma lets it go.

FOUR! Beautiful shot once again from Bavuma. He has not hit this hard but just used the pace of Starc. Fuller on off, Bavuma gets on his front foot and just places the ball through covers for a boundary. The outfield is very quick here at the Boland Park.
Swing and miss. Starc goes full and wide outside off, Bavuma goes chasing after it but misses.
Short ball around off, Bavuma sways away from it.

Full on leg, de Kock flicks it through mid-wicket. Cummins in the deep covers a lot of ground and stops the ball with a slide before the ropes. Saving a run for his side. Good work from Pat in the deep.
Good length ball on off, Bavuma defends it with a dead bat to get through the over.
On the pads, Bavuma glances it fine down the leg side and gets a couple as the fielder from fine leg cleans it up.
Good fielding from Smith. Full around off, Bavuma drives it square to the left of point. Steven Smith dives on that side and saves a certain boundary.
Fuller on middle, Temba strokes it to mid on.
Play and a miss. Good ball from the Australian pacer. He hits the deck hard around off, Bavuma looks to defend but the ball shapes away and beats the batter.
On the pads, de Kock glances it to the leg side and gets a single.
Almost chopped on! Length delivery around off, de Kock looks to run it down towards backward point but he gets an inside edge which goes wide of the stumps and down the leg side. Single taken.
Length delivery on off, de Kock blocks it.
On the pads, de Kock flicks it wide of fine leg and gets a couple.

FOUR! Majestic from the South African skipper. He is in sublime form and this shot shows that. Full and wide outside off, de Kock is onto it in a flash. He gets on his front foot and drives it perfectly through covers. The ball races away to the fence. First boundary for Quinny.
Length delivery on off, de Kock defends it.
Oh! Length delivery on off and middle, Bavuma looks to glance it to the leg side but gets a leading edge which goes towards cover. They steal a single.
Good length delivery around off, de Kock defends it to get through the over.
Away from the off pole, de Kock lets it be.
Length ball around off, Bavuma runs it down to third man for a run.

FOUR! Glorious from Bavuma again. This one is even prettier than the last boundary. Good length delivery on off, not a half volley at all. Bavuma just gets on his front foot and drives it perfectly through covers for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Bavuma leaves it alone.

FOUR! Gorgeous from Bavuma. Hazlewood starts with a good length delivery outside off, nothing wrong with the delivery. Bavuma just lunges forward and creams his drive through covers. The fielder gives it a chase from covers but comes second best. First boundary of the game.
Josh Hazlewood to operate with the second new ball.
On the pads, de Kock flicks it to the on side and gets a couple to get off the mark. Excellent first over from Starc. 3 runs and a wicket off the first over.
Very full on middle and leg, de Kock taps it back to the bowler.
Ohh!! Good length ball on middle and leg, it swings into the southpaw. De Kock looks to defend but gets an inside edge and the ball gets stuck on his pads.
South Africa are off the mark! On the pads, this time Bavuma flicks it towards fine leg and gets a single to get the scoreboard up and running.
Good length ball on the pads, once again it shapes in to the right-hander. Bavuma looks to flick but misses.
Temba Bavuma walks out at number 3. He is potentially opening the batting here.

OUT! LBW! It has hit the boot first and it is an excellent review from Australia. They strike on the very first ball of the game. Terrible start for Malan on his ODI debut. He grabs a golden duck in his first outing. Superb bowling from Starc. Nobody wants to face such peach at the start of the innings and definitely not on debut. Starc steams in and bowls a very full ball on middle and leg. It is almost on a yorker length. It angles in beautifully to the right-hander. Malan looks to flick but misses. There is a huge appeal from the Aussies but the umpire turns it down. Aaron Finch signals the 'T' after a brief thought. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows that the ball hit the boot before the bat. Ball Tracker then rolls in and it shows three reds. Malan has to walk back and his dream day has turned into nightmare. Perfect start for Australia.

Review straightaway on the first ball. It is for an LBW. Janneman Malan is the man in question. Has the ball hit his pad first or has it hit the bat? If it has hit the pad then it will be difficult for Malan to survive. Let's see what the replays have to say.

We are all set for the action to begin. The Australian side are in a huddle before they take their respective position in the field. South African skipper, Quinton de Kock and Janneman Malan stride out to open the innings for South Africa. Mitchell Starc to start the proceedings with the first new ball.
Australia Playing XI - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, D'Arcy Short, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (WK), Mitchell Starc, Pat Cummins, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

South Africa Playing XI - Quinton de Kock (WK/C), Janneman Malan (ODI DEBUT), Temba Bavuma, Kyle Verreynne (ODI DEBUT), Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj, Anrich Nortje, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch says it is a dry wicket and hopes that it remains the same. Informs, Hazlewood, Labuschagne and Short are in the side in place of Kane Richardson, Ashton Agar and Matthew Wade. Tells Marnus has had a great year and hopes that he can continue. On the final T20, Finch says it was great and especially because it was a 'finals like game'.

South African skipper, Quinton de Kock says that it is a good wicket and might stop later hence the decision. On the ground, he says it is a lovely stadium and it is a good day though there is a cloud cover. Tells it is a great time to give the young guys a chance. On Bavuma's return, he says it is great to have him back as he is in good form in white-ball cricket.
TOSS - It's toss time! South African skipper, Quinton de Kock spins the coin. Australian skipper, Aaron Finch calls it incorrectly. SOUTH AFRICA OPT TO BAT!

Hello and welcome to the first ODI between South Africa and Australia. After an entertaining T20I series, it is time for the longest format in white ball cricket. South African skipper, Quinton de Kock will hope to get over the line after losing the T20Is. The hosts will want other players to stand up and deliver along with their skipper. Australia, on the other hand, will look to continue their good form and take the momentum from the shortest format. The Aussies have been clinical and would look to continue that. Can the rebuilding South African side take an early lead in this short series or will the Aussies pile on their misery?
